A '''sarlacc''' that had lived for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duroon]] [[Death/Legends|died]] of disease<ref name="A Sarlacc's Stomach" /> around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The sarlacc's body was dragged above ground by [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologists]], who inspected the creature's stomach for preserved antiquities and valuables.<ref name="A Sarlacc's Stomach" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Duroon sarlacc was first mentioned in the Archaeology crewskill mission "A Sarlacc's Stomach" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="A Sarlacc's Stomach" />
